title: 第3章 演技派对强硬派第4章 能别老坑师父吗
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
四长老揉了揉眼睛，一脸不可思议道：“我靠，我没看错吧！”
“万剑归宗，而且已经达到了化境？”
即便是他们这些长老达到化境也需要磨练加领悟几百年才可能练成，还不是一定能达到。
而且武技的等级越高，修炼起来就越难，万剑归宗可是地级武技，就连他们也没达到这个程度。
这小子才多大呀，就将一门地级武技练到化境，可见他的天赋有多恐怖？
五长老也回过神来道：“你没看错，而且还有剑意的加持！”
剑意那是修剑之人可遇不可求的意境，就连他们也是到了元婴期以后才触碰到剑意的门槛。
只有七师妹那个妖孽在金丹期就领悟了剑意。
这小子的境界，炼气期？
这就不能用妖孽来形容了，这就是剑道之子啊！
五长老掌管任务殿，由于秦峰常年不做任务，没少遭到他的白眼，还向穆无双打小报告来着。
现在他无比后悔，原来这家伙深藏不露，他巴结还来不及呢。
四长老不可思议道：“这真是秦峰那小子？一天就知道喝酒，连任务也不做的酒痴？”
其他人都木讷的点了点头，他们的震惊一点都不比四长老少。
天空中正在大战的穆无双跟楼万里也停止了打斗，此刻的楼万里鼻青脸肿，像猪头一般。
嘴角还溢出丝丝血迹，那模样要多凄惨，有多凄惨。
这还是穆无双念及同门，并没有下死手。
二人迅速来到武道台旁边。
一脸不可思议的看着这一幕，楼万里反应过来，立即冲进大坑，悲痛的喊道：
“小川！”

穆无双也立刻来到秦峰面前道：“老二，有没有伤到哪里？”
说着立刻给秦峰来了个全身检查。
最让人无语的是，她居然扒开秦风的嘴看了看牙齿，发现一颗没少，这才放下心来。
搞得清风都有些不好意思了。
自己又没有受伤，他是打别人的好不好？师父也太严重了。
秦峰尴尬一笑道：“师父，我没事。”
穆无双点了点头，又给罗凤拿了两颗顶级的疗伤丹药。
罗凤脸色涨红道：“对不起师父，我给你丢人了！”
穆无双摆摆手：“说什么傻话，胜败乃兵家常事。”
“为师像你这么大的时候，也，咳……”
说到这里，她有些说不下去了，她从小到大可都是一路横推的角色，都不知道什么叫失败。
一时间都不知道该怎么安慰了。
她也是第一次当师父，这三个徒弟都当宝贝一样，除了老二懒一点，其他两个她都舍不得打。
不过这次老二算是给她争脸了，没想到这小子居然深藏不露，回去要好好表扬。
她组织了一下语言，安慰道：“反正你不用在意就是了，那小子不已经被老二打趴下了吗。”
“反正我们杀剑峰没输，你回去好好修炼，以后再打回来就是了。”
说话间楼万里抱着奄奄一息的于川从大坑中走了出来。
一阵哀嚎声：
“我的乖徒儿啊，你死的太惨了，她们师徒太欺负人了，下手一个比一个黑。”
content_en:
The fourth elder rubbed his eyes and said with a look of disbelief on his face: "Damn, I saw that right!"
"Wan Jian has returned to the sect and has reached the transformation state?"
Even if elders like them reach the transformation state, it will take hundreds of years of training and understanding to achieve it, and it is not guaranteed to be achieved.
Moreover, the higher the level of a martial skill, the harder it is to practice. Wanjian Guizong is an earth-level martial skill, and even they have not reached this level.
How young is this kid? He has already mastered an earth-level martial arts to the realm of transformation. Does this show how terrifying his talent is?
The fifth elder also came back to his senses and said: "You read that right, and it is also blessed by sword intent!"
Sword Intent is an artistic conception that those who practice swords can only encounter but cannot seek. Even they only touch the threshold of Sword Intent after reaching the Nascent Soul Stage.
Only the seventh junior sister, that evildoer, understood the meaning of the sword at the golden elixir stage.
This kid's state, Qi refining stage?
This cannot be described as a monster, this is the son of the sword!
The fifth elder was in charge of the mission hall. Since Qin Feng did not do missions all year round, he often looked down upon him and even reported to Mu Wushuang.
Now he regretted it immensely. It turned out that this guy was hiding his secrets and it was too late for him to flatter him.
The fourth elder said in disbelief: "Is this really that kid Qin Feng? A drunkard who only knows how to drink in one day and doesn't even do tasks?"
The others nodded dully, and they were no less shocked than the Fourth Elder.
Mu Wushuang and Lou Wanli, who were fighting in the sky, also stopped fighting. At this moment, Lou Wanli's nose was bruised and his face was swollen, like a pig's head.
There was still a trace of blood spilling from the corner of his mouth, how miserable and miserable he looked.
This was because Mu Wushuang was thinking of his fellow disciples and did not kill him.
The two quickly came to the martial arts stage.
Looking at this scene with an expression of disbelief, Lou Wanli reacted and immediately rushed into the pit, shouting sadly:
"Ogawa!"
Mu Wushuang also immediately came to Qin Feng and said, "Second brother, are you injured anywhere?"
After saying that, he immediately gave Qin Feng a full body check.
The most speechless thing was that she actually opened Qin Feng's mouth and looked at the teeth, and found that there was not one missing, so she felt relieved.
It made Qingfeng feel a little embarrassed.
He was not injured, so he hit someone else, okay? Master is too serious.
Qin Feng smiled awkwardly and said, "Master, I'm fine."
Mu Wushuang nodded and gave Luo Feng two more top-notch healing pills.
Luo Feng's face turned red and she said, "I'm sorry, Master, I've embarrassed you!"
Mu Wushuang waved his hand: "What nonsense are you talking about? Victory and defeat are common matters for military strategists."
"When I was as old as you, as a teacher, well..."
At this point, she couldn't go on. She had been pushed around since she was a child, and she didn't even know what failure meant.
I didn’t know how to comfort him for a while.
It was also her first time to be a master, and all three of her apprentices were treated like treasures. Except for the lazier second one, she couldn't bear to beat the other two.
But this time, the second child was trying to win face for her. Unexpectedly, this kid actually kept it secret. He wanted to praise her well when he got back.
She organized her words and said comfortingly: "You don't have to worry about it anyway. Hasn't that kid been beaten to the ground by his dick?"
"Anyway, we didn't lose in Killing Jianfeng. You just go back and practice hard, and then you can fight back again."
While talking, Lou Wanli walked out of the pit holding the dying Yu Chuan.
A wailing sound:
"My good disciple, your death is too tragic. Their master and disciple are too bullying, and each one is worse than the other."
